candidates.title: Abyssal relay
candidates.summary: Dark teal trench, quiet center, bioluminescent green and magenta on vent towers, a chimney block, and five separated obstacle modules.

collision.openings: transparent margin around the body; upper-left steps are outside the rock
gaps between modules stay non-solid; the bent rib is an open arc

spec.target_display: 800x600 viewport. Keep the center darker than bullets.

limitations: Scenery cliffs run off the left, right, and bottom edges. The open center is transparent.
Wall is one placed module, not a seamless tile. A single rectangle includes empty space beside the upper-left steps. Chimney smoke is decorative.
The bent rib is an arc. One rectangle across it would cover the opening. Dish and pod cracks are surface holes.
Far painting is softer than the flatter wall and obstacle sprites. A few warm lamps remain on the right scenery tower.

background-far was replaced by abyssal-background-1448.png (1448x1086, opaque). abyssal-background.png (1280x720) is unchanged. The new file is the same trench reframed to 4:3 from that painting, then scaled up from the generator JPEG (1152x864). The center stays quiet and the edge lamps remain, with a darker water band added above and below. It is a repaint, so lamp and particle positions drift slightly and the whole frame is a little darker.
Not placed in a level and not checked in the game viewport.
